preconditions.description: The root must be a valid TreeNode object.
The sum must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(path, list) for path in paths)
postconditions.description: Each path in the output must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == sum for path in paths)
postconditions.description: The sum of each path in the output must equal the given sum.
The number of paths in the output must be non-negative.
